ESS: (sum weights)^2/sum squared weights; descriptive weight dispersion only, invariant to global scaling; not bias or full-design variance
analysis_indicator: C=all five raw baseline stress items observed; not merely survey returned
calibration: sum complete analysis weights=N_g within each recorded frame group
confidence: center poststratified estimate, radius sqrt(Vmax/alpha), clip to1..5. At least95% under the declared conditional uniform-mask design; no posterior or validated Tonmick coverage. Logical item bounds reported separately; no estimated-variance normal interval.
guards: N_g>0, n_g>0 and n_g>=2 unless group is census; nonpositive/undefined response rates, raw support, joins and malformed toy/spec fail closed
normalization: multiply analysis weights by n_complete/N for mean1 among analyzed people; ratio mean invariant
prior_knowledge: Prior observed/World rules and all earlier book cases known before freeze; not blind preregistration. No hidden Tonmick score or reveal used.
recalibration: within-group calibration after equal-weight cap restores N_g/n_g and can undo cap
response_design: conditional on positive n_g, complete-score sets are independent uniform subsets of size n_g within each fixed invitation group; all full reference scores fixed. Working observation assumption, not an actual randomized response design. Implies conditional unbiasedness; stronger than mean transport alone.
score: mean of five keyed items; st4=6-raw; incomplete scores remain blank
toy_order: lexicographic sorted retained-ID combinations,3 of first4 and2 of last4
toy_selection_failure: deterministically retain lowest3 Y in group0 and lowest2 Y in group1, ID tie-break; no coverage claim for this outcome-dependent mechanism
trimming: clip unnormalized complete-score weights at1.5; report lost calibration and implied composition; do not recommend cap or borrow untrimmed variance
variance_bound: sum_g (N_g/N)^2 (1-n_g/N_g) 4*N_g/((N_g-1)*n_g), zero for a fully observed group; scores bounded1..5
variance_estimator: sum_g (N_g/N)^2 (1-n_g/N_g) s_g^2/n_g, where s_g^2 is complete-score sample variance using n_g-1; zero for a fully observed group
